newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korea's Sept foreign exchange holdings fall.
newsitem.headline: S.Korea's Sept foreign exchange holdings fall.

text.p: South Korea's foreign exchange holdings totalled $32.84 billion at the end of September, down from $33.56 billion a month earlier, the Bank of Korea said on Wednesday.
A statement from the central bank said the foreign exchange holdings fell due to a continued current account deficit.
South Korea had $32.71 billion in foreign exchange reserves at the end of calendar 1995, up from $25.67 billion at the end of 1994, it said.
